intent: Let an ordinary task proceed in a fresh chat while a separate host collector records metadata for explicitly enrolled sessions.
worker_context: Only the user's actual task and its normal instructions. No research-history fork, measurement skill, hypothesis, score or database prompt.
store: Owner-local SQLite outside the worker checkout; actual paths live in gitignored local configuration.
implemented_metrics: Hook receipt timestamps and event counts for enrolled sessions
Observed tool starts and ends, with stable tool identity deduplication
Reported model, permission mode and subagent lifecycle metadata when supplied
Explicit incomplete coverage and collection diagnostics
Externally classified captured contacts and corrections, with append-only revisions
Explicit user-reported resolution and scoped first-pass resolution; missing classifications remain unknown
Explicitly reported active human minutes, never inferred from message timestamps
Sanitized selected-session manifests linked to consistent private snapshots

unknown_metrics.tokens: No qualified Codex usage adapter in this prototype.
unknown_metrics.cost_usd: No complete metering or observed billing source.
unknown_metrics.actual_task_wall_time: Receipt times are not execution boundaries.
unknown_metrics.full_tool_coverage: Some host tool paths do not emit these hooks.

blinding_claim: Task instructions need not disclose evaluation; complete inability to discover or infer observation is unverified.

activation.enrollment: explicit session or one-shot exact host/directory with expiry

limits: Simulated hook tests validate this collector, not native host integration.
Hook metadata alone cannot establish successful tools, complete reviewers, independent acceptance or causality.
Collector overhead and missing arrivals may affect observations.
No skill package was changed or installed.
Event metadata excludes prompts/tool content/paths. Private pending enrollment stores a directory for routing.
The native Claude task was blocked by usage credits; its captured failure is preserved.
Native diagnostic logs and SQLite snapshots remain private.
First-pass resolution concerns captured, fully classified records with explicit user resolution; it is not complete-conversation success.
